import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
facts_path = Path('/tmp/pantheon-root01a15322-resume-20261111/TW-REFRESH-LATEST-CLOSED-SESSION-20261113-sanitized-source-facts.json')
facts = json.loads(facts_path.read_text())
archive = Path(facts['official_artifact'])
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    outcomes = {n: json.loads(z.read(n)) for n in z.namelist()}
assert outcomes == facts['outcomes']
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', facts['workflow_head'] + ':scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh'], text=True)
blob = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', facts['workflow_head'] + ':scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh'], text=True).strip()
assert blob == facts['script_blob_verified_via_GitHub']
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('refresh_tests', root / 'scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
rows = []
for filename, outcome in outcomes.items():
    profile = (outcome['connector_id'], outcome['dataset'])
    now = datetime.fromisoformat(outcome['checked_at'])
    states = ('fresh',) if profile not in module.CHIP_PROFILES else ('missing', 'stale', 'fresh')
    for state in states:
        kwargs = {'profile': profile}
        if profile in module.CHIP_PROFILES:
            kwargs['readback'] = None if state == 'missing' else module._preflight_readback(profile, '2026-11-11' if state == 'stale' else '2026-11-12')
            kwargs['source_records'] = module._preflight_broker_coverage()
        old_result = module._run_preflight_script(False, now, module._preflight_snapshot(), script_text=old, **kwargs)
        assert old_result['status'] == outcome['status'] and old_result['reason'] == outcome['reason']
        new_result = module._run_preflight_script(False, now, module._preflight_snapshot(), **kwargs)
        expected = ('skipped' if profile not in module.CHIP_PROFILES else 'noop' if state == 'fresh' else 'proceed')
        assert new_result['status'] == expected
        rows.append({'official_outcome_file': filename, 'fixture_state': state, 'old': old_result, 'new': new_result})
report = {
    'workflow_run': facts['workflow_run'], 'workflow_head': facts['workflow_head'], 'verified_script_blob': blob,
    'official_zip_sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'sanitized_facts_sha256': hashlib.sha256(facts_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'historical_state_limit': 'ZIP establishes outcomes only; injected readback/snapshot fixtures are controlled alternatives, not historical database claims.',
    'official_outcomes': outcomes, 'controlled_old_new_decisions': rows,
}
Path('/tmp/tw-refresh-reproduction.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
